text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock C because they were above my average cost, but a gain relative to my purchase price alone does not tell me whether selling is the right decision.","My account value fell over these periods despite those profitable sales; I should judge my overall portfolio and future prospects, not treat each stock as a separate account.","I should avoid holding a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake, while also avoiding unnecessary trades; make decisions from risk, diversification, and the evidence rather than my feelings about my purchase price."]}
